record.title: ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex Cloud are experiencing elevated conversation errors

updates.body:
We have identified that users are experiencing elevated errors for the impacted services.

We are working on implementing a mitigation.

We have identified that users are experiencing elevated errors for ChatGPT and ChatGPT Work, as well as cloud Codex threads.

We have identified the issue and are working on implementing a mitigation.

We are seeing improvements following our mitigations. Some users may continue to experience elevated errors across ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex cloud threads. We are continuing to work toward full recovery.
